pages.name: Courtney
pages.text: It's believed so. It seems Jean found a way to locate its general position, some magical stuff he's been dealing with in the basements. One night he screamed "I found it!" and the next morning a bunch of soldiers went off on a "special mission" to Abel, then we got the weird orders. Suspicious, isn't it? Well, since then I saw no more special missions, so I assume it's still here in the castle.
